request:
Can you rewrite this so normal people can read it? It goes on the council website tomorrow.

"Notice is hereby given that, pursuant to scheduled infrastructure renewal works, vehicular access to Harbour Road between its intersections with Mill Street and Quay Lane shall be suspended for the period commencing 0600 hours Monday 3 March and concluding 1800 hours Friday 7 March. Alternative routing via Station Parade is advised. Pedestrian access shall be maintained at all times."

Also, while you're at it: can you check whether Station Parade can actually take the extra traffic? I don't really know what you can and can't do.

Please use Station Parade instead.

You can still walk along Harbour Road the whole time."
